feedback: The current geometry with sensor y-positions shifted forward by +0.005 improved early line detection but still results in one line loss event per run, causing off-track terminations on both oval and s-bend tracks. The controller compensates with moderate base speed and gains but cannot fully prevent line loss, indicating the need for further geometry refinement. The sensor size of 0.016 and wheel track of 0.16 provide good noise robustness and turning stability, so these should be retained. The forward shift of sensor y-positions is beneficial but may need slight further adjustment or complementary changes to sensor x-positions or sensor count to enhance line detection and control anticipation further.
requested_changes: Increase sensor y-positions by an additional +0.005 (e.g., from 0.06, 0.04, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06 to 0.065, 0.045, 0.025, 0.045, 0.065) to further improve early line detection and reduce line loss events.
Consider slightly increasing sensor count to 7 sensors to improve line coverage and detection robustness, maintaining sensor size at 0.016 for noise robustness.
Explore minor adjustments to sensor x-positions within [-0.08, 0.08] to optimize lateral line sensing and control anticipation, aiming to reduce steering oscillations.
